author: Stahly
description:
Rattle cans, airbrushing, spray varnish, enamel thinners, solvents: The Warhammer hobby exposes your lungs to a surprising range of hazardous particles and chemical fumes, and an open window and even an airbrush extractor unit aren't enough. A proper respirator mask is one of the most important and most overlooked pieces of kit any miniature painter can own. Here's what to look for, plus our budget recommendation that covers everything you need for under £30 / 30 € / $30.

The post Stop abusing your lungs: this is the affordable respirator mask every hobbyist needs appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Stop abusing your lungs: this is the affordable respirator mask every hobbyist needs
